high_level_description: The image depicts a fashion show or runway event taking place indoors. The setting appears to be a modern, minimalist space with white walls and a grid-patterned ceiling. The model is wearing a beige trench coat over a black outfit, paired with black boots that have a distinctive fringe detail at the bottom. The model's head is not visible, as it is cropped out of the frame. On either side of the runway, there are rows of seated spectators.
